 Never played, already gone. JJ Gabriel leaves Man United
 Teenage football star JJ Gabriel has made a cinematic farewell to Manchester United fans. Known as the ‘Kid Messi’, the 16-year-old posted a goodbye video despite never having made a first team appearance. Gabriel is expected to join Real Madrid in January.
